Config.Serial.Fido2: Serial number / internal ID of the key
Config.Hint.Fido2: Plug in the key. Windows will ask for the key's PIN and a touch. The method will be named FIDO2-<serial number>.
Config.Hint.FixedTotp: Enter the serial number and secret from the manufacturer's data. The activation code is calculated from the secret.
Config.Hint.ProgrammableTotp: A new secret is generated and activated. Then program the card using the QR code or the secret.
Config.Hint.Tap: Valid immediately for 2 hours, can be used multiple times. An existing TAP will be replaced.
Config.Hint.FakeMfa: Registers a TOTP with a random secret that is discarded immediately. MFA will always be required at sign-in.
Config.ConfirmReplaceTap: The user already has a Temporary Access Pass. It will be deleted and replaced with a new one.
Mfa.Hint.AdminNoPhishingResistant: Administrator without a phishing-resistant method: add a FIDO2 key, passkey or Windows Hello.
Mfa.Hint.RemoveWeak: SMS/call is also registered and can be removed.
Mfa.Hint.RemoveFake: Fake MFA is still registered and can be removed.
Mfa.Hint.UpgradeWeak: Set up the Authenticator app, TOTP or FIDO2, then remove SMS/call.
Mfa.Hint.FakeOnly: The user cannot sign in until a real method has been set up (e.g. via TAP).
Mfa.Hint.TapOnly: The user should now use the TAP to register a permanent method (Authenticator, FIDO2).
Mfa.Hint.None: Set up MFA: issue a FIDO2 key, a TOTP card or a TAP so the user can register the Authenticator.
Mfa.Hint.RemoveTap: An active TAP exists – delete it after setup.

BreakGlass.Info2: • Until the FIDO2 key is registered, a fake MFA protects the account. It is removed afterwards.
BreakGlass.Info3: • Afterwards, exclude the account from Conditional Access policies and set up a sign-in alert.
